# Space Bunny public-run assessment

**Disposition:** `openrouter/stealth/space-bunny-alpha` is the first currently available exact-zero route in this campaign observed completing a campaign-owned public research run through the real local API, durable engine, public literature/MCP tools, and report publication. Select it for a controlled campaign production check with the existing safety and claim gates intact. One completed run is evidence of operational compatibility, not a measured reliability rate or scientific superiority. Do not describe the mechanisms as validated.

## Operational evidence

The [selection record](m12-free-route-selection-2026-09-27.md) and [one-call smoke](m12-space-bunny-smoke-2026-09-27.json) preceded the full run. The public EGFR-mutant lung cancer goal used the express tier and the same exact model for all roles. The original run failed after 73 tasks because an analyzed Europe PMC article had `authors: null`; contact extraction iterated it before any overview-model call. A red node-level test reproduced that local bug. Commit `17f1c851` guarded the missing author list; [same-run recovery](m12-space-bunny-resume-receipt-2026-09-27.json) revived the existing task row and preserved the run ID and checkpoint. The run then [completed 75/75 tasks](m12-space-bunny-completed-run-2026-09-27.json) and published a report. Durable pause/resume was also exercised earlier in the same run ([receipt](m12-space-bunny-recovery-2026-09-27.json)).

Immediately before recovery, the [fresh catalog receipt](m12-space-bunny-zero-price-admission-2026-09-27.json) showed exact `stealth/space-bunny-alpha`, one Stealth endpoint, and zero for every listed price. The route pins Stealth, disallows provider fallback and applies zero token-price caps; the app performs fresh free-price admission on campaign requests. All recorded served-model entries identify Space Bunny. The completed run recorded 155 physical attempts, 154 observed provider calls, 141 logical calls and $0 internal estimated cost. The [OpenRouter account readback](m12-space-bunny-final-key-usage-2026-09-27.json) showed no usage or balance change from the mid-run and post-failure snapshots. Account readback may lag and cannot attribute a charge to one run; OpenRouter does not document the request-price cap as binding. Its [current endpoint listing](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/stealth/space-bunny-alpha/endpoints) showed zero prompt, completion and discount prices at recovery time.

The retained [compressed Markdown report](m12-space-bunny-report-2026-09-27.md.gz) is the exact 356,767-byte publication artifact (uncompressed SHA-256 `ef54ca2d6142db4706e396b38ce85f2a12cf31fc4171283eab97ffa075dfc5c5`). No private documents or notifications were used. The local browser loaded the workbench, showed a labeled access form, rejected an invalid dummy code, and reset cleanly on refresh ([receipt](m12-space-bunny-browser-2026-09-27.json)); authenticated viewing of this report in the browser was not exercised. The affected offline suite, lint, typecheck, evaluation smoke and browser E2E passed after the null-author fix; frontend unit tests and build remain applicable from the unchanged frontend revision.

## Scientific limits and provenance

The report has 61 public evidence records, 8 explored ideas and 3 published directions. The [persisted claim evaluator](m12-space-bunny-persisted-evals-2026-09-27.json) counted 48 assessed claims: 3 `supports`, 6 `partial`, 39 `insufficient` (81.25% without support). Three ranked directions concern ERBB2/MET, DUSP6/MET/ERK and MET/contractility/TEAD; they are falsifiable proposals, but each was weakened by deep verification and needs revision. The core causal links are insufficiently supported. The report's `verified_count=3` means each released direction has at least one supported or partial edge, not that its central mechanism is established. All 26 deterministic citation rows were `unsupported`. Some references are off-topic. These limits must travel with any release note or model-default decision.

The retrieval-replay evaluator found zero `retrieval_calls` alongside 61 evidence rows. For express tier, this is expected: ordinary literature review populated source records, while the separately budgeted deep-research phase that writes replayable call ledgers is reserved for extended/ultra. The result is **not** a replay pass or a regression. Source identifiers and public links remain in the retained report and [run receipt](m12-space-bunny-completed-run-2026-09-27.json). No expert or wet-lab validation and no matched-model scientific comparison were performed. The owner explicitly asked to stop broad model benchmarking; this descriptive run must not be used to claim a quality improvement over another model.
